name: momentos-en-vivo
description: Fotografías para eventos, con acceso separado por cliente.

scripts.start: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --config firebase.local.json --project demo-momentos --only auth,firestore,storage,functions,hosting
scripts.test: node --test tests/security.test.cjs tests/projection-state.test.cjs tests/music.test.cjs tests/frame-sequence.test.mjs tests/secret-setup.test.cjs tests/payment-setup.test.cjs tests/payment-gateway.test.cjs tests/webhook-setup.test.cjs tests/album-signing-setup.test.cjs tests/sandbox-admin.test.cjs tests/mercadopago-mcp.test.cjs
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-momentos --only auth,firestore,storage "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/integration.test.cjs tests/commerce.test.cjs tests/presentation.test.cjs tests/moderation.test.cjs"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.local.json --project demo-momentos --only auth,firestore,storage,functions,hosting "node scripts/browser-suite.cjs"
